module mg_04695(clk, reset, full, parallel_out, serial_in);
input clk; 
  input reset; 
  output reg full; 
  output [7:0] parallel_out; 
  input serial_in; 
  reg serial_p; 
  reg serial_s; 
  reg [3:0] state; 
  reg [8:0] shift; 
  reg [10:0] count; 
  assign parallel_out[7:0] = shift[7:0]; 
  always @(posedge clk) begin 
  serial_p <= serial_in; 
  serial_s <= serial_p; 
  end 
  always @(posedge clk) begin 
  if (reset == 1) begin 
  state <= 4'h0; 
  full <= 0; 
  end else begin 
  if (state == 4'h0) begin 
  full <= 0; 
  if (serial_s == 0) begin 
  state <= 4'h1; 
  count <= 651; 
  end 
  end else 
  if (state == 4'hb) begin 
  state <= 4'h0; 
  full <= 1; 
  end else begin 
  if (count == 0) begin 
  state <= state + 1; 
  shift[8:0] <= { serial_s, shift[8:1] }; 
  count <= 1302; 
  end else begin 
  count <= count - 1; 
  end 
  end 
  end 
  end 
 endmodule
